units.source_text: 后来，他常常到本州岛的各地短途旅行。

en.t: Later, he often took short trips to various places on Honshu.

units.source_text: 但是木曾的粗狂自然风景令他感觉不安，濑户内海优雅的自然风景又令他感觉无聊。

en.t: But the rugged natural scenery of Kiso made him uneasy, while the graceful scenery of the Seto Inland Sea bored him.

units.source_text: 和那些美丽的、卓越的自然风景相比，他更热爱寒酸的自然风景。

en.t: Compared with those beautiful and magnificent natural landscapes, he loved shabby scenery more.

units.source_text: 尤其热爱那些在人工文明当中苟延残喘的自然风景。

en.t: He especially loved natural scenery that barely survived amid man-made civilization.
